description: Xcel Energy: Hosting Capacity is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. The hosting capacity map display is a high level estimate of the available hosting capacity for adding distributed generation. Hosting capacity is defined as the amount of generation that can be accommodated at a point on the distribution system without requiring some mitigations such as specialized inverter settings or infrastructure upgrades. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Renewables. Its keywords are hosting capacity maps, hosting capacity. The portal shows 2025-10-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
